mapper.select: SELECT TEST_ID AS testId, TEST_NAME AS testName, TEST_DESC AS testDesc, USE_YN AS useYn, REG_DT AS regDt FROM TEST_T ORDER BY TEST_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TEST_T ( TEST_ID, TEST_NAME, TEST_DESC, USE_YN, REG_DT ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(TEST_ID), 0) + 1 FROM TEST_T), #{testName}, #{testDesc}, #{useYn}, SYSDATE )
